threshold_name: No open P0 or failed-exercise corrective action
minimum_evidence_required: deficiency ledger with zero open P0, failed exercise retest pass, closure owner, independent verifier, closure date

threshold_name: Current EP01/EP02/EP04 public ROP signal reconciled to local evidence
minimum_evidence_required: quarterly PI values or official page capture plus local drill/equipment logs; EP03 not accepted as current

threshold_name: Alerting works under blackout, telecom degradation, language, and access stress
minimum_evidence_required: IPAWS/WEA/EAS/siren/local fallback test logs, delivery/reach analysis, backup power, LEP/accessibility materials, failed-delivery reconciliation

threshold_name: Current ETE and evacuation route capacity are proven
minimum_evidence_required: ETE date, scenario assumptions, roadway constraints, traffic control, shadow evacuation, reception capacity, shelter-in-place fallback

threshold_name: No-car, disability, school, childcare, hospital, and LTC movement plans are capacity-backed
minimum_evidence_required: current aggregate registries, contracts, vehicle availability, staff ratios, reunification, medical continuity tests

threshold_name: CRC/decon throughput can handle peak arrival
minimum_evidence_required: CRC layout, staffing, equipment, contamination control, data system, privacy, throughput test, bottleneck retest

threshold_name: KI is fenced to thyroid-radioiodine use only
minimum_evidence_required: KI inventory/distribution/protocol plus explicit non-substitution for evacuation, shelter, decon, food/water control, medical surge, or recovery

threshold_name: Ingestion-pathway food, milk, agriculture, livestock, and water controls are executable
minimum_evidence_required: lab capacity, sampling chain-of-custody, embargo authority, alternate water supply, producer/worker outreach, disposal plan

threshold_name: Reentry, relocation, registry, claims, and cleanup decision clock exists
minimum_evidence_required: decision log fields, dose/cleanup criteria, relocation assistance, claims intake, registry governance, legal aid, behavioral health, waste interface

threshold_name: FEMA AAR and corrective-action closure are linked to local rows
minimum_evidence_required: FEMA AAR or public-safe abstract, areas requiring corrective action, strengths, improvement plan, closure evidence, sensitive appendix boundary

threshold_name: Advanced-reactor 50.160 performance objective branch cannot borrow large-LWR evidence
minimum_evidence_required: performance objective metrics, capability demonstration, offsite interface, public information, quarterly evidence window, corrective-action closure

threshold_name: Public claim survives no-average-away and sensitive-publication checks
minimum_evidence_required: public-safe claim gate, score-state exclusivity audit, redaction review, counterevidence check, retired-source check, appeal/correction path
